faqs.question: How do I list a property?
faqs.answer: Create an account, select the seller role and use Add Property to submit your listing.

faqs.question: Can I search properties by location?
faqs.answer: Yes. Search by city, locality, state, property type, budget and configuration.

faqs.question: How do I contact a seller?
faqs.answer: Use the enquiry or contact option available on an eligible property listing.

faqs.question: How are properties verified?
faqs.answer: GHAR can review submitted property and ownership documents before approval.

faqs.question: Can I save properties?
faqs.answer: Yes. Authenticated users can save eligible listings for later.
